items.text: Quick and on a length on off, going across Hope, who helps it off his pads through fine leg. The in-fielder was positioned too wide, and the fielder in the deep was too square so it's another boundary for Hope
Eased down to long-on

High and handsome! Ishan Kishan at deep midwicket can only watch it sail over. This is a long hop on off from around the wicket and Hetmyer is quick to pounce, rocking back, clearing his front leg and swatting it away

items.preText: Prince Yadav returns to the attack
items.text: Length ball outside off, clipped down to long-on

items.preText: Azweer : "The West Indies are causing absolute carnage!"
items.text: Oh, a wicket against the run of play! And it's a big one too! 137kph length ball on leg and Hetmyer was cramped a bit. Tries to club it away but the bat turns in his hands as the ball strikes it around the toe end and flies back to the bowler. Prince with some good reflexes to hold on in his follow through

dismissal.text: SO Hetmyer c & b Prince Yadav 33 (19m 12b 4x4 2x6) SR: 275

items.preText: Rovman Powell joins Hope in the middle
items.text: Full outside off, 139kph, Powell eases it towards cover and wants a single. Hope says no
items.shortText: Prince Yadav to Powell, no run

items.text: Full outside off, tapped towards cover and this time they do steal a single
Prince goes short, but too short. Hope watches it sail well over and settle in Samson's gloves
Good yorker on off, Hope is able to jam his bat down and squeeze it down to long-on for a single
Yorker on off, blocked to the bowler's right. Gets it past a scrambling Prince Yadav for a single

items.preText: It's Gautam Gambhir's birthday today, but he isn't the solution to WORD PLAY. Find the seven-letter word as fast as you can.
items.text: On a length around off, blocked back to the bowler's right
Fuller outside off, driven out to the off side
Full on off, blocked on the front foot
Goes back to this length ball and whips it down to long-on
Full and flat on middle, going on with the angle, clipped through square leg
On a length outside off, punched down to long-on and that'll be drinks
items.postText: And with that, it's time to say hello to Abhijato. Let him know in the comments how many you guys think West Indies will end up with! Abhi, what do you make of Hope's innings so far?

items.preText: Hello hello. Thanks, Abhimanyu. I'll keep all the Hope-based puns to one side and just say that he's set for a big one here. Let's see how WI approach the backend of this innings. Daren Sammy has fruits in a plate he is munching on while he chats with his players during the drinks break. Absolute cinema! Mukundan: "Anything less than 250,India will chase it" - The relaid pitch isn't quite as flat as that, surely...
items.text: Too short and Hope latches onto this from outside off! But he can't quite middle this and the ball goes, on the bounce, out to deep midwicket

Now pitched fuller, but Hope latches onto this even better! Huge swing through the line outside off and he sends it out towards deep midwicket, where Kishan puts in a superb stop and sends it back so quickly that Hope has to rush to make it back home
Back of a length and thuds into his pads, as he is rushed on this flick

In the slot and Hope has reached his fifty in boshing fashion! Was thumped down the track and Hope continues his superb run of form, acknowledges the dugout and crowd, a 28-ball effort for him and he looks set for more here
Hard length, on the stumps, he pulls this out towards deep midwicket
Hit on the hips, rushed for pace once more! Was back of a length and rockets past him swivelling at his crease as he looks to swat this across the line

items.preText: Azweer : "Player of the Tournament - Shai Hope. " - Great shout!
items.text: On a length drifting down the pads, he flicks this out to long leg
On a length at the stumps, he sweeps this fine! Was a decent delivery but he just sweep-scoops this out towards deep fine leg
Dances down the track and he's elevated this over long-on! Was a slot ball once he had met bat on ball, and he lofts this over the bowler's head with pure muscle
